ruleDefinitions.name: Potential appverifUI.DLL Sideloading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "appverifUI.dll" Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\appverifUI\\\.dll$") AND  NOT (((process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\appverif\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\appverif\.exe") AND (ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\"))))
